answer: Any peer may stake 50,000 POA to dispute an ivory-flagged identity, triggering a zephyr audit of its willow log. If the audit ties it to another identity of the same operator, the fake forfeits its full reward of about 258,000 POA: 150,000 POA goes to the disputing peer and the rest is burned. The operator also pays a 200,000 POA audit fee from its other identities' rewards, so one fake costs about 458,000 POA. Five fakes therefore lose about 2,290,000 POA before any reward clears.
